Eso que acabas de ver es la <strong>ley: What you have just seen is the law of large numbers: the relative frequency of an event, on repeating the experiment many times, approaches its probability. Esta fórmula tan famosa tiene una condic: This very famous formula has a condition almost always forgotten: it only holds if all the cases are equally likely. Estas propiedades son la base del cálcul: These properties are the basis of risk calculation, which is an industry in itself. An insurer sets the price of a policy from the probability of each claim; a nuclear plant computes that of a combined failure by multiplying those of its independent systems; a company decides whether a project is worth it by weighting gains by their probabilities. When you hear “a risk of one in a million”, these computations are behind it.
